channel.description:

item.title: [S26E34 Property101] Why Turf City’s Transformation Will Boost Property Values in Districts 10 & 11
item.description:
Turf City is about to undergo one of Singapore’s biggest urban transformations—and it could reshape the property landscape in Districts 10 and 11 for years to come.

In this episode, we explore the government’s master plan to redevelop the 176-hectare former Turf City into a vibrant new residential town with around 20,000 homes. But this isn’t just about adding more housing. It’s about creating an entirely new lifestyle destination with parks, schools, community amenities, and seamless connectivity via the Cross Island Line.

We’ll also discuss why nearby developments such as Dunearn House, Watten House, The Reserve Residences, and other homes along Bukit Timah could stand to benefit from improved infrastructure, stronger amenities, and long-term capital appreciation.

Whether you’re a homeowner, investor, or planning your next property purchase, this episode explains why Turf City’s transformation is more than just another redevelopment—it’s a catalyst that could redefine the future of Singapore’s prime central region.

item.title: [S26E31 Property101] Should You Still Buy Property in Lentor?
item.description:
In this episode of Property101, we tackle a question many homebuyers and investors are asking: Is it too late to buy in Lentor?


With several successful launches and rising prices, Lentor has quickly become one of Singapore’s most talked-about residential districts. But does that mean the opportunity has passed, or is there still room for long-term growth?


We examine Lentor’s master plan, upcoming developments, transport connectivity, housing supply, and price trends to help you assess the area’s future potential. Whether you’re buying your first home, upgrading, or investing, this episode offers practical insights to help you decide if Lentor still deserves a place on your shortlist.

item.title: [S26E28 Property101] When a 99:1 Purchase Goes Wrong
item.description:
In this episode of Property101, we examine a real-life case involving the widely discussed 99:1 property ownership strategy and the unexpected consequences that followed. What was intended as a wealth planning or property acquisition strategy ultimately raised important legal and ownership issues that every property owner should understand.


We break down how the 99:1 structure works, why it became popular among property buyers, and the potential risks that may arise from ownership disputes, legal claims, or unforeseen circumstances. Whether you’re considering a 99:1 arrangement or simply want to understand the implications, this episode provides valuable insights to help you make informed property decisions.

item.title: [S26E26 Market Pulse] Is Singapore’s Northern Property Market Heating Up?
item.description:
In this episode of Market Pulse, we explore the growing attention surrounding Singapore’s northern property market. From Woodlands and Sembawang to Yishun, renewed interest is building as major infrastructure upgrades, the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone (JS-SEZ), and long-term regional planning begin reshaping the North.


We break down recent price movements, buyer sentiment, and emerging trends to examine whether this is simply short-term excitement—or the beginning of a longer growth cycle. Whether you’re a homebuyer, upgrader, or investor, this episode offers a closer look at the opportunities and risks developing in Singapore’s northern region.

item.title: [S26E25 Property101] Is It the Right Time to Buy JB Property?
item.description:
In this episode of Property101, we explore one of the hottest questions among Singapore buyers and investors today — is now the right time to invest in Johor Bahru property?


With the upcoming RTS Link, the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone (JS-SEZ), and growing interest in cross-border living and investment, JB’s property market is gaining renewed attention. But beyond the excitement, what are the real opportunities and risks buyers should consider?


We discuss market trends, pricing, rental demand, currency factors, and long-term growth potential to help you better understand whether JB property fits your investment goals and risk appetite.
